parameters.help_en:
The identity ID of the Resource Access Management (RAM) user synchronization. Valid values:

When `PrincipalType` is set to `Group`, the value is the CloudSSO group ID (g-********).
When `PrincipalType` is set to `User`, the value is the CloudSSO user ID (u-********).

The filter takes effect only when PrincipalType is also specified

RAM用户同步的身份ID。取值：

parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The token used to return the next page of query results. You do not need to specify `NextToken` when you call this operation for the first time.

If the total number of entries returned exceeds the `MaxResults` limit when you call this operation for the first time, the data is truncated. Only the number of entries specified by `MaxResults` is returned, the `IsTruncated` response parameter is set to `true`, and a `NextToken` is returned. You can use the returned `NextToken` to call this operation again while keeping other request parameters unchanged to query the truncated data. You can repeat this process until `IsTruncated` is set to `false`, which indicates that all data is queried
parameters.help_zh:
查询返回结果下一页的令牌。首次调用API不需要`NextToken`。

当您首次调用API时，如果返回数据总条数超过`MaxResults`限制，数据会被截断，只返回`MaxResults`条数据，同时，返回参数`IsTruncated`为`true`，返回一个`NextToken`。您可以使用上一次返回的`NextToken`继续调用API，其他请求参数保持不变，查询被截断的数据。您可以按此方法多次查询，直到`IsTruncated`为`false`，表示全部数据查询完毕
parameters.name: next_token

DeletionStrategy.description_en:
The deletion policy. This policy specifies how to handle the synchronized Resource Access Management (RAM) users when the Resource Access Management (RAM) user synchronization is deleted. Valid values:

Delete: Delete. When the Resource Access Management (RAM) user synchronization is deleted, the Resource Access Management (RAM) users that have been synchronized from CloudSSO to Resource Access Management (RAM) are deleted.
Keep: Keep. When the Resource Access Management (RAM) user synchronization is deleted, the Resource Access Management (RAM) users that have been synchronized from CloudSSO to Resource Access Management (RAM) are retained
DeletionStrategy.description_zh:
删除策略。删除RAM用户同步时，对已同步的RAM用户的处理策略。取值：

Delete：删除。删除RAM用户同步时，会删除从云SSO已经同步到RAM中的RAM用户。
Keep：保留。删除RAM用户同步时，会保留从云SSO已经同步到RAM中的RAM用户

DuplicationStrategy.description_en:
The conflict resolution policy. This policy specifies how to handle the situation when a CloudSSO user is synchronized to Resource Access Management (RAM) user with the same name already exists. Valid values:

KeepBoth: Keep both. When a CloudSSO user is synchronized to Resource Access Management (RAM) user with the same name already exists, the system appends the `_sso` suffix to the CloudSSO username and attempts to create a RAM user with the new username.
TakeOver: Replace. When a CloudSSO user is synchronized to Resource Access Management (RAM) user with the same name already exists, the system directly replaces the existing RAM user with the synchronized CloudSSO user
DuplicationStrategy.description_zh:
冲突策略。当云SSO用户同步到RAM时，如果RAM中存在同名用户时的处理策略。取值：

KeepBoth：两者都保留。当云SSO用户被同步到RAM时，如果RAM已经存在同名用户，则对云SSO用户的用户名添加后缀`_sso`后尝试创建该用户名的RAM用户。
TakeOver：替换。当云SSO用户被同步到RAM时，如果RAM已经存在同名用户，则直接将已经存在的RAM用户替换为云SSO同步用户
